senses.gloss:
जिगीषत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, wishing or striving to
overcome, emulous, ambitious, a warrior.
जिगीषमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, striving to win.

जिगीषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to gain or obtain,
seeking for; striving to conquer or overcome, or to
excel, vying or contending with; (उस्), m., N. of a
man.
—जिगीषु-ता, f. desire of conquering, emulation.
जिग्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. victorious, triumphant.

जिगत्नु जिगत्नु, उस्, उस्, उ (reduplicated
form fr. rt. गम्), going quickly, fleet; (उस्), m.
breath, life.

जिगमिषत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (fr. Desid. of rt. गम्),
wishing or endeavouring to go.
जिगमिषा, f. wish to go or move, intention to go.

जिगमिषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to go, intending
or purposing to go.

जिगरिषु जिगरिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of
rt. 2. गॄ), wishing to swallow or devour, desirous of
seizing.

जिगर्ति, इस्, m., Ved. a swallower, devourer;
swallowing.
